headline: Import-Export Documentation Assistant
summary: Documentation assistant with three years handling import and export shipments for an agricultural trading company in Quirino. I prepare shipping and customs documents, coordinate deliveries with forwarders and suppliers, and track stock in transit. I also help purchasing with orders and supplier negotiations.
skills: Inventory tracking of goods in transit

experience.title: Import-Export Documentation Assistant
bullets: Prepare invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and customs entries for about 25 shipments a month.
Coordinate pickups and deliveries with forwarders and brokers in Manila and Subic.
Track goods in transit and update the stock report when shipments arrive.
Help the purchasing team issue purchase orders and compare forwarder quotes.

experience.title: Documentation Clerk
bullets: Prepared bills of lading and delivery receipts for trucking clients.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Customs Administration
